Theme C — Bayside Neon 湾岸ネオン
maximalist

わんがんネオンOverview

The Tokyo bayfront at 2am — ink-violet black, magenta signage, cyan cutting through. In light mode it inverts to the mall at midday: chrome, glass and lilac-white tile, with hard offset shadows replacing the glow.

Risk note. This is the loud one. It is the most likely to read as pastiche and the most likely to fatigue on the dense, repeating surfaces Bluelist is mostly made of. Saturated colour is kept to chrome, headings and accents; body rows stay on --text-color. Try the decoration toggle both ways — that is the real decision here.

カラーPalette

Every value is checked against both the page and the card background; the figure shown is the lower of the two.

タイポグラフィTypography

Chakra Petch 700 uppercase with 0.12em tracking for headings, Inter for body, IBM Plex Mono for data. Scale ratio 1.333 — poster-like. The vaporwave fullwidth convention (ＡＥＳＴＨＥＴＩＣ) is deliberately not used; it breaks screen readers and text selection, so wide tracking does the same job safely.

Suggested lists

Body copy is Inter at 16px with a 1.6 line height, deliberately plain. All of the theme's personality is carried above this line — the moment display styling reaches body copy in a list-heavy app, readability goes.

ボタンButtons

Zero radius. Primary is a magenta→violet gradient. With decoration on it gains a glow (dark) or a hard chrome offset (light).

インターフェースInterface

Note the gradient rules on the header and cards — these cannot be done with border-color, so they need pseudo-elements. That is the real CSS cost of this family.
